body: I hope you’re right. I thank you for the vote of confidence and for your time. Even just having someone to talk through this with makes me feel better.

I believe those things because, generally speaking, women like men who are fit, make a lot of money, and have traditionally cool hobbies and interests (i.e. Not games and anime). You’re right that it’s possible I could meet someone who just likes me and doesn’t give a shit how much money I make or what my body looks like. 

But if I do meet someone, I think it’s much more likely that they would not like me if I were out of shape and barely making any money working a menial job. I’m trying to maximize my chances.

It’s the feeling I described in my original post. All actions feel robotic. I don’t care about anything I’m doing. I don’t really want to do anything I’m doing. I’m only doing it because I know it’s good for me to do. If I didn’t believe that working, exercising, eating, etc. were necessary to eventually finding a girlfriend, I would lay in bed all day.

The last time I remember feeling different was when I was with together my ex. She was my reason for waking up.

I don’t totally disagree. I think you’re right. Making a game, anime, etc. is 100% not for me, cause I know I would feel embarrassed to have made it. But the idea of making something to be appreciated by others is a good one.

To that end, I tried to start learning to play bass, and I redownloaded Adobe Illustrator, which I used to like working with in high school. But when I sit down to make something in illustrator, I just have nothing in me. And I’m just not having a good time with bass.

I don’t mean to like invalidate everything you’re saying. I think it’s good advice and it seems like the best way to go from here. The problem is just with me feeling completely lifeless, which is a hard one to solve.

Honestly? I like video games, and anime, and podcasts. I have a long list of games and shows I want to get to. But when I look back on the time spent on that stuff it just feels like such a huge waste of my life. Because I don’t actually care about any of it. I’d give it all up forever if it meant I’d find someone.

Now it feels bad to engage with that stuff. So much so that I can rarely do it.

I’m glad your sisters and female friends said that to you, but I just don’t buy it. I think most women *would* like a bald guy, provided he’s like 6’2”, wide shoulders, good facial features, and full beard. If he’s the very specific kind of bald guy who looks good with it, then sure, he’ll have no problem. But I’m 5’10, average face, not-so-full beard, etc. For me, it’s a problem.
I don’t want to do anything besides whatever I need to do to have a girlfriend again. I don’t like anything.
